display_title: My Child Was Abducted by Aliens
description:
A schoolgirl’s uniform was found late at night in a wooded area. After inspecting the scene, police suspect a violent crime and begin searching for the missing person. The missing girl is Cheon Ji-Yun, a second-year student at Cheongwang Middle School. She disappeared while investigating In Yu-Jin, a senior at her school who went missing four years ago. The detectives recall a famous statement made by In Yu-Jin’s biological father at the time.

 *“My child was abducted by aliens.”*

And so, the case gradually drifts into the realm of fantasy.

(Source: Naver, translated)
